```sql
with scope as (
    select o.order_id
    from orders o
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
    where not o.is_test
      and s.region_id in ('IN-TN')
      and ci.name = 'Chennai'
      and o.business_date = date '2026-09-09'
),
tried_upi as (
    select a.order_id,
           max(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded
    from payment_attempts a
    join scope sc on sc.order_id = a.order_id
    where not a.is_test
      and a.method = 'upi'
    group by a.order_id
)
select null as key,
       cast(sum(succeeded) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from tried_upi
order by value
```
